meta.author: DJ panel generation audit (docs/reviews/round4-generation.md)
meta.keys: trackEnergy keys are normTitle|orchestraId (accents stripped, parentheses removed, lower-case); a key without a year applies to every version of that title by that orchestra. Values are floor intensity 0-100 and carry an opener/closer gradient inside each famous tanda so shapeTanda has something to sort.

osvaldo-pugliese.notes: maxPerNight must be a number (the {4:1,6:2} object is read as a string and disables the cap). notAfter 1 so Pugliese may be the ultima (corpus: most common final tanda before La Cumparsita). Closing Cumparsita: 1959 instrumental only; never the 1970/1979/1989 Cordoba vocals.

juan-d-arienzo.notes: phase 'any' so D'Arienzo passes the close-slot phase filter; the engine must still fix the energy-vs-position weighting for the first 1935-39 instrumental tanda. Closing versions per corpus rule 16; the undated rows and the 1943 row are not closing versions.

carlos-di-sarli.notes: 1950 and 1942 rows are not the versions DJs close with.

nonDanceTitles: Selección de temas de Francisco Canaro
anibal-troilo.notes: The catalogue rows La Cumparsita 1938/1951/1952/1953 are mis-dated transfers; only 1943 and 1963 exist as closing versions.

angel-d-agostino.notes: cumparsitaCount:2 appended the 1952 Tino Garcia vocal to a Vargas 1945 tanda; the corpus pairing is D'Agostino-Vargas 1945.

francisco-canaro.notes: Tita Merello 1956 sides (Nino bien, Pipistrela, Se dice de mi, Cambalache) are actress show-songs; they opened the post-golden preset as tanda 2. The engine must read singerDanceable.

osvaldo-fresedo.notes: Catalogue rows Por Calles Muertas / Volveras / Cafetin de Buenos Aires / Arrabalero dated 1940 are decade placeholders (Cafetin de Buenos Aires was written in 1948); they must not form a 1939-40 instrumental opener.

orquesta-tipica-victor.notes: The golden-era OTV vals pool is three female-vocal 1940 singles each; the canonical OTV vals tanda (Vargas/Pomar/Morales 1937-40) cannot be built from the catalogue (Temo missing; Sin rumbo fijo under Vargas, Noches de invierno under Morales). Until that is fixed VALS_BANK for OTV should be 2, not 8.

pedro-laurenz.notes: del Rio 1952-53 tandas appeared at the peak of the 6 h plateau and in the beginner set; bestYears [1937,1944] must be read by the engine.

lucio-demare.notes: Quintana 1944-45 was programmed six times across twelve seeds while Miranda appeared twice; singerShift (Miranda +2, Quintana -2) is in the JSON but unread.

miguel-calo.notes: Calo/Dante 1935-36 appeared at 90 % of a night (S3 #20); the 1934-36 Calo belongs, if anywhere, in the warm-up.

notes: BLACKLIST_TITLES in packages/core/src/energy.ts bans 'mala junta' and 'cafe dominguez' by bare title; Pugliese Mala junta 1943 and D'Agostino Cafe Dominguez 1955 are among the most repeated tanda openers in the reference corpus and must be allowed. The entries 'quejas de bandoneon (concierto)' and 'la yumba (concierto)' can never match because normTitle strips parentheses.

orchestra_profiles.json maxPerNight for Pugliese is an object {4:1,6:2}; compose.ts/tanda.ts read it as a number, producing a string cap that never triggers. Until the engine resolves it by hours, this patch sets it to 1.

Catalogue: six Francisco Canaro 1935-38 rows flagged vocal:false duplicate Roberto Maida vocals (Hotel Victoria, Callecita de mi Novia, Suplicio, No Cantes Ese Tango, Desencanto, Olvidame). Only Hotel Victoria 1935 is a genuine instrumental; the others should be vocal:true / singer Maida or hidden as duplicates.

Catalogue: Osvaldo Fresedo rows Por Calles Muertas, Volveras, Cafetin de Buenos Aires, Arrabalero carry placeholder year 1940 (yearApprox). Cafetin de Buenos Aires is a 1948 composition. These rows formed the opener 'Fresedo instrumental 1939-1940' in 5 generated sets.

Catalogue: Troilo/Fiorentino Malena 1940 and Bajo un cielo de estrellas 1940 are placeholders (1942 and 1941); Biagi Racing Club 1950 and A la gran muneca 1950 are placeholders (1940 and 1945); D'Arienzo La punalada 1943 and Corrales viejos 1943 are doubtful dates. yearApprox rows must not define a tanda's year window.

Catalogue: La Cumparsita rows Anibal Troilo 1938 (Fiorentino), 1951, 1952, 1953 and Juan D'Arienzo 1943 / undated are not closing versions; closing versions in the corpus are D'Arienzo 1951/1963/1937/1955, Troilo 1963/1943, Di Sarli 1955, D'Agostino-Vargas 1945, Biagi 1942, Pugliese 1959, De Angelis 1961, Canaro 1951. The 'cumparsitaVersions' arrays in the profiles above are the proposed per-orchestra allow-list.

Catalogue: the OTV vals tanda Sin rumbo fijo / Temo / Noches de invierno (Vargas/Pomar/Morales 1937-40, canonical ct-203) cannot be assembled: Temo is missing and the two present sides sit under different singer ids. Until fixed, OTV should not carry a vals-bank weight of 8.

context_factors.json: beginner / milonguero / encuentro options lack preferStyles and avoidStyles, so the engine's 'rhythmic, no dramatic' rule for beginners is lost whenever the research model is loaded; heatwave/hot milongaShare (0.12/0.11) is overridden by season summer (0.18) because resolveContext keeps the first absolute share it sees; vocalRatioShift and tempoShift are computed but never applied.

cortinas: the 'global' default pool has no genre family with >= 8 members, so every default night draws from all 26 built-ins (swing, jazz, soul, funk, surf, rock, synth, 80s, 2024 pop, lo-fi). The removals above take out the cues a room will dance to or that date the set (lo-fi, surf, Twist and Shout, cumbia, Mesecina, Espresso); the engine still needs a lower family threshold and LRU cycling.

Guardia-vieja preset: cortinaStyle 'constant' picked Lou Reed 'Walk on the Wild Side' (1972) for 28 consecutive cortinas of a pre-1935 night; the constant cortina should be filtered to year <= 1935 or a dedicated 1920s pool.

Energy: famousRecordings[].energy is a per-orchestra heuristic, so all famous tracks of one family share one value (1538 famous rows, 497 distinct values); the trackEnergy block above restores a gradient for the tandas the engine builds most often (opener slightly below closer, test track lowest) so shapeTanda and the corpus role field can order them.
